# يَحْيَوْنَ (yaḥyawna) /jaħ.jaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of حَيَّ (ḥayya) and حَيِيَ (ḥayiya)
# يُحْيَوْنَ (yuḥyawna) /juħ.jaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of حَيَّ (ḥayya)
